csv_project_name: Consultant For Local Bridge Program Delivery Assistance
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Pennsylvania, Department of Transportation, District 6, may be seeking a consultant to provide Local Bridge Project Delivery Assistance in Bucks, Chester, and Montgomery Counties The Agreement will be for a period of 5 years. with projects assigned on an as-needed basis.The work and services which may be required under this Agreement are to support the Department and our local bridge project sponsors with the advancement of local bridge improvement projects. Multiple bridge projects are being advanced concurrently including some with short schedules. The engineering work and services that may be required under this contract include, but are not limited to: review structure designs (including type, size and location reports, core boring layouts and foundation designs and reports), assist with alternative analysis to assess and mitigate impacts, develop scopes of work and Municipal estimates for consultant agreements, prepare reimbursement agreements, and manage/monitor schedules of locally designed projects. These engineering services identified are the general work activities that can be expected under this Open-end Agreement. A more specific and project-related Scope of Work will be outlined for each individual Work Order developed under this Open-end Agreement. The areas of environmental study which may be required under the Agreement include, but are not limited to: cultural resource coordination, Section 4(f) evaluation coordination, early coordination and scoping correspondence meeting, minutes, public meeting presentations, NEPA/Act 120 documentation, review of mitigation plans and reports These environmental studies identified are the general work activities that can be expected under this Open-end Agreement. A more specific and project-related Scope of Work will be outlined for each individual Work Order developed under this Open-end Agreement.
